system.name: Zeus
system.one_liner: a system that jointly optimizes GPU power limit and training batch size to reduce the energy consumption of DNN training

components.name: Zeus
components.role: the recurrent-job energy optimizer, containing the power and batch-size optimizers

components.name: Power Optimizer
components.role: determines the GPU power limit for a job

components.name: JIT Profiler
components.role: just-in-time profiler used by the power optimizer

components.name: Batch Size Optimizer
components.role: selects the training batch size for a job

components.name: Bandit
components.role: multi-armed-bandit algorithm used by the batch size optimizer to explore/exploit batch sizes

components.name: NVML
components.role: interface used to read GPU power stats and set GPU power config

components.name: DL Execution Engine
components.role: executes DNN training with the given batch size and power configuration, reporting training stats

components.name: GPU
components.role: underlying hardware on which training and power control run

content.key_idea: Zeus sits between job submission and the DL execution engine, using a JIT-profiling power optimizer and a bandit-based batch-size optimizer to iteratively pick and refine energy-efficient training configurations from observed GPU power and training statistics.
content.reading_order: top-down through four circled stages: Job Submission of recurrent jobs with an optimization metric, into Zeus's Optimization box (Power Optimizer / Batch Size Optimizer), down to Execution on the DL Execution Engine and GPU, and Observation feeding stats back up via NVML and the execution engine.

users submit recurrent DNN training jobs (a tuple of data, model, optimizer, and the target validation metric) to Zeus, along with a set of feasible batch sizes B and power limits P to explore
Zeus then predicts the optimal batch size and power limit conﬁguration based on past execution history

summary: This figure shows Zeus's high-level workflow as a four-stage top-down pipeline. Users submit recurrent training jobs (Job1, Job2, Job3) along with an Optimization Metric (ETA & TTA) to Zeus (step 1). Inside the dashed Zeus box (step 2, Optimization), a Power Optimizer with a JIT Profiler determines the GPU power limit, while a Batch Size Optimizer using a multi-armed Bandit algorithm selects the batch size. These choices become a DNN Training Config sent down to the DL Execution Engine and a GPU Power Config sent to NVML for Execution (step 3). The Observation stage (step 4) feeds GPU power stats and DNN training stats back up from NVML and the DL Execution Engine to Zeus, closing the loop that lets Zeus refine future configurations from execution history.
summary_zh: 该图展示Zeus工作流：作业连同优化指标提交给Zeus，其内部功耗优化器（JIT剖析器）与批大小优化器（Bandit算法）确定配置并下发执行引擎与NVML，再从中获取功耗与训练统计以形成闭环观测。
